messages.text:
Hello,

I noticed my B30 miner is also shipping with a 3 month RMA and Diagnostics.
What is meant by "Diagnostics"? And what are the details about RMA?

I'm asking about the RMA details because I am seeing several posts in the
Discord about B30 issues, i.e. not being able to reach the advertised 30 TH
and be stable, heating problems, and bad chips.

Thanks,

Rob
Handed to the team · Exact RMA terms (start date, return shipping, coverage after 3 months) are not i

Hi Rob,

"Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA" is a free line that comes with your B30 at no charge. It has two parts. "Diagnostics" means our technical team helps you work out what is wrong if the unit misbehaves. "3-Month RMA" means that if we find a real hardware fault in the first three months, the unit is covered for a return. Some older orders show this line as "Harlo OS · Diagnostics". It is the same service and does not include any firmware.

This is how a claim works. You tell us what the miner is doing. We start with the simple fixes: pool settings, firmware, power, airflow and the error or log line. If a part like a fan, power supply or screen is the problem, we deal with it without the miner coming back. If the fault is on the board itself, the unit comes back under the RMA. That includes dead or undetected chips, a failed voltage regulator or a short. A short video of the fault and a photo of the serial number make this much faster.

About the problems you've seen on Discord:

1. Hashrate: the B30 is listed at 30 TH/s, and up to 30 TH/s is normal use. Settings above 30 TH/s count as overclocking and are at your own risk. If damage comes from too much voltage, frequency or heat, coverage may not apply.
2. Heat: most heat problems come from airflow or room temperature, not a faulty unit. Give the B30 open space at the front and back, and keep an eye on the chip temperatures in the web interface.
3. Bad chips: chips that aren't detected or don't hash from the first power-on are a board fault. That is the kind of problem the RMA covers.

I don't have the exact terms in front of me. I can't confirm whether the three months start on the ship date or the delivery date, or who pays for return shipping. I've asked the team to confirm those details. They pick it up today at 10am ET, and the answer will come to this email.

For setup help once the miner arrives, the Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf is very active. Mention @nullhashrate there to reach JD, our hardware lead.

Hal, HeliumDeploy technical support
